run_NAS_superindividual_training: run a PyTorch training loop for a super-individual NAS model on CIFAR-10 with cosine annealing LR
train_model_on_cifar10: train a Network model on CIFAR-10 with gradient clipping, SGD optimizer, and DropPath regularization
infer_model_validation_accuracy: infer validation accuracy and loss for a Network model using a CIFAR-10 validation data loader
resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume training a super-individual NAS model from a saved model.pt checkpoint with optimizer and scheduler state
encode_supernet_architecture_masks: encode a masked_code string into supernet normal and reduce masks using translator and generator encoders
